record.name: Uzbekistan
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The AI centre under the digital ministry promotes and reviews AI projects, with no model-evaluation mandate.

related_bodies.name: Centre for the Development of AI and the Digital Economy
related_bodies.role: It runs the national AI portal and monitors AI projects. It is a state body under the Ministry of Digital Technologies. It is not a model-evaluation institute.

An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
